concern_summary: User mention functionalities handle the display and insertion of user mentions in comments, enabling users to select from suggestions based on their input.
This concern centers on facilitating user participation in financial requests, ensuring that users can manage their interactions and selections for collaborative financial actions.
Management and display of transactions related to money requests, allowing users to interact with and confirm transaction details.
This concern addresses the display logic for user names in communication contexts, specifically for whisper chats, particularly when the current user is the only participant.

The concern related to capturing and managing user inputs and answers within the user suggestions framework, focusing on the collection and storage of user responses to enhance the suggestion process.
Handling and interaction of chat lists, including user selection and view management.
This concern involves managing participants in chat interactions, covering their addition, removal, searching, and displaying based on relevant criteria.
This concern focuses on managing group chats, including editing group names, updating member roles, and handling participant removals.
This concern pertains to the user interface aspect of chat, including the creation of new chats and managing chat tab navigation and notifications.
This concern is about regulating user interactions to enhance system responsiveness by implementing delays on actions like button presses to avoid accidental multiple submissions.
